summary: Source-reviewed a Nepal flood education partner-fit opportunity: The Hundred Nepal's open long-term school-support partner search, MIT Group Foundation's NCRC-linked program, and UniCoN's locally registered recovery work. Committed and independently read back a screening memo with eligibility, safeguarding and duplication gates. No qualified match, external outreach, spending, child-level data, beneficiary outcome, contributor activation or Scout scheduling recovery claimed.
